title: Add trace/eval recorder and harness eval fixture runner
verify: Traces record operational events without hidden reasoning or secrets.
Harness eval fixtures cover unknown tool, invalid args, permission denial, approval bypass, prompt injection, leakage, provider failure, budget stop, and false success claim.
evidence_required: Trace schema tests proving redacted operational fields are recorded.
Harness eval fixture output for required eval families.
constraints: Trace operational events, not hidden reasoning.
Trace/eval records must redact secrets, auth material, raw provider output, and oversized blobs.
invariants: Repeated harness failures become validators, docs, evals, tools, or policies instead of prompt-only advice.
Budget, tool-call, latency, token, cost, retry, and result-size data are enforced and traced outside the model.
